description: Implementation of SavingsDropdownReadPlatformService providing dropdown options for savings account configurations such as withdrawal fees, lock-in periods, interest periods, and calculation types.

classes.name: SavingsDropdownReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation class providing dropdown options for savings account settings.

methods.name: retrievewithdrawalFeeTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns options for withdrawal fee types (flat or percent of amount).

methods.name: retrieveLockinPeriodFrequencyTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns options for lock-in period frequency types (days, weeks, months, years).

methods.name: retrieveCompoundingInterestPeriodTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns options for interest compounding periods (daily, monthly, quarterly, bi-annual, annual).

methods.name: retrieveInterestPostingPeriodTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns options for interest posting periods (daily, monthly, quarterly, biannual, annual).

methods.name: retrieveInterestCalculationTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns options for interest calculation types (daily balance, average daily balance).

methods.name: retrieveInterestCalculationDaysInYearTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns options for days in year types (360 days, 365 days).
